answer: Require every agent to lock a small slashable stake before it can trade, and tie reputation to one persistent identity instead of disposable accounts. A newcomer starts as a faint ember: it may only take tiny jobs and must earn trust through completed work, with each job's thread of payments and reviews publicly linked to that one identity. Good actors gradually build a harbor of verified history that cheap clones cannot copy, because faking months of consistent attested work costs far more than the stake is worth. Sybils stay small, slow, and unprofitable.
